## About
Plaza Tire & Wheels is a tire and wheel shop on Veterans Memorial Dr in Houston. We carry high performance tires and wheels for passenger cars, SUVs and light trucks, from staggered and luxury wheels to tuner and off road styles.
We know a new set of wheels and tires is a big purchase, so we take our time mounting, balancing and installing them. We are not trying to rush you out the door.
Beyond tires and wheels, we do general mechanic work on foreign and domestic vehicles, including oil changes, brakes, shocks, struts, alignment and transmission fluid flushes. Call us and we will talk through what your vehicle needs.

## Services
- High performance tires and wheels: Tires and wheels for passenger cars, SUVs and light trucks.
- Alignment: We bring your vehicle's alignment back to factory specifications.
- General mechanic services: Oil changes, brakes, shocks, struts, alignment and transmission fluid flushes.
- Removable vinyl wrap: A new look for your car without a re-spray, and it can be safely removed.
- Wheel repair: Ask us about repairing your wheels.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign and domestic vehicles?
A: Yes. Our general mechanic services, like oil changes, brakes and alignment, are available for both foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: What kinds of wheels do you carry?
A: We carry staggered, luxury, tuner and off road wheels.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: No, we are closed on Sunday.
